minecraft:zombie.summary: An undead melee enemy and a useful early source of crafting drops.
minecraft:zombie.encounter: Appears at night on the surface and in unlit underground areas. Ordinary Zombies burn in sunlight unless protected.
minecraft:zombie.advice: Their carried equipment can make two Zombies very different threats.

minecraft:skeleton.summary: A ranged undead enemy that pressures exposed players.
minecraft:skeleton.encounter: Appears at night and in dark caves. Ordinary Skeletons burn in sunlight unless protected.
minecraft:skeleton.advice: [[item/minecraft:bone|Bones]] and arrows make them useful gathering targets.

minecraft:creeper.summary: A silent explosive enemy that punishes careless approaches.
minecraft:creeper.encounter: Appears in dark Overworld locations, including the surface at night.
minecraft:creeper.advice: A [[mob/minecraft:skeleton|Skeleton]] or [[mob/minecraft:stray|Stray]] kill can produce a [[item/minecraft:music_disc_5|Music Disc]].

minecraft:spider.summary: A climbing enemy that is dangerous in darkness.
minecraft:spider.encounter: Appears in dark Overworld locations. In bright conditions, an unprovoked Spider is normally neutral.
minecraft:spider.advice: Walls alone are poor protection because it can climb. [[item/minecraft:string|String]] is a useful reward for ranged and textile crafts.

minecraft:cave_spider.summary: A small venomous [[mob/minecraft:spider|Spider]] associated with abandoned mine workings.
minecraft:cave_spider.encounter: Usually encountered around Cave Spider spawners in Mineshafts, rather than ordinary surface spawning.
minecraft:cave_spider.advice: Clear webs and make room to retreat. A small opening may not keep it out.

minecraft:husk.encounter: Appears on desert surfaces in darkness. Unlike ordinary [[mob/minecraft:zombie|Zombies]], Husks do not burn in sunlight.

minecraft:stray.encounter: Appears in snowy environments in darkness. [[mob/minecraft:skeleton|Skeletons]] can also become Strays through prolonged Powder [[item/minecraft:snow|Snow]] exposure.

minecraft:bogged.encounter: Appears in swamps and mangrove swamps in darkness, and can be selected by Trial Chamber spawners.
minecraft:bogged.advice: Its poison arrows reward cover and quick engagements. Shearing a Bogged can yield mushrooms.

minecraft:drowned.encounter: Appears in rivers and oceans; submerged [[mob/minecraft:zombie|Zombies]] can also convert into Drowned.
minecraft:drowned.advice: Fight from a position with reliable air and room to move. Only a Drowned carrying a [[item/minecraft:trident|Trident]] can drop that weapon; a carried [[item/minecraft:nautilus_shell|Nautilus Shell]] is another notable reward.

minecraft:zombie_villager.summary: An infected [[mob/minecraft:villager|Villager]] that can potentially be cured.
minecraft:zombie_villager.encounter: Can appear among [[mob/minecraft:zombie|Zombie]] spawns or result from a [[mob/minecraft:villager|Villager]] being killed by a [[mob/minecraft:zombie|Zombie]], depending on difficulty.
minecraft:zombie_villager.advice: If you want to cure it, protect it from sunlight and other damage, then use Weakness and a [[item/minecraft:golden_apple|Golden Apple]].

minecraft:enderman.summary: A neutral teleporting enemy with a valuable Pearl drop.
minecraft:enderman.encounter: Appears in several dimensions. Overworld encounters favour dark conditions; the End has especially many Endermen.
minecraft:enderman.advice: Looking directly at its face or attacking provokes it. Water and low shelter can help control the fight.

minecraft:slime.summary: A splitting enemy and the main renewable source of Slime Balls.
minecraft:slime.encounter: Spawns in suitable slime chunks below Y40 regardless of light, and in swamps under suitable night, moon and light conditions.
minecraft:slime.advice: Larger Slimes split into smaller ones. A surface swamp hunt is more affected by the moon than a suitable underground chunk.

minecraft:witch.summary: A hostile potion user and source of varied ingredients.
minecraft:witch.encounter: Appears in dark Overworld locations, around Swamp Huts and in raids. Lightning can transform a [[mob/minecraft:villager|Villager]] into a Witch.
minecraft:witch.advice: Expect varied effects rather than a simple melee exchange. Interrupt the fight with cover when you need to recover.

minecraft:phantom.summary: An airborne undead enemy linked to missed sleep.
minecraft:phantom.encounter: Can appear at night near players who have not rested for several nights, provided the local conditions allow it.
minecraft:phantom.advice: Sleeping prevents the usual insomnia-driven encounters.

minecraft:silverfish.summary: A small enemy that can emerge from infested blocks.
minecraft:silverfish.encounter: Found around Strongholds and infested blocks, including suitable mountain terrain.
minecraft:silverfish.advice: Additional Silverfish can turn a small encounter into a swarm.

minecraft:endermite.summary: A short-lived hostile creature associated with [[item/minecraft:ender_pearl|Ender Pearls]].
minecraft:endermite.encounter: Can occasionally appear when a player uses an [[item/minecraft:ender_pearl|Ender Pearl]].
minecraft:endermite.advice: It is small and short-lived; do not confuse it with a naturally recurring underground population.

minecraft:pillager.summary: A ranged Illager that uses a [[item/minecraft:crossbow|Crossbow]].
minecraft:pillager.encounter: Found around Pillager Outposts, in patrols and in raids.
minecraft:pillager.advice: Captains and ordinary Pillagers have different implications for Ominous activities.

minecraft:vindicator.encounter: Encountered in Woodland Mansions and raids.
minecraft:vindicator.advice: Its melee threat is different from a [[mob/minecraft:pillager|Pillager]]'s ranged pressure.

minecraft:evoker.summary: An Illager caster with summoned attackers and ground attacks.
minecraft:evoker.encounter: Encountered in Woodland Mansions and raids.
minecraft:evoker.advice: A [[item/minecraft:totem_of_undying|Totem of Undying]] is its distinctive reward.

minecraft:vex.encounter: Usually summoned by [[mob/minecraft:evoker|Evokers]] rather than naturally spawning as a population.
minecraft:vex.advice: It can pass through blocks, so ordinary walls do not provide the same safety as they do against ground enemies.

minecraft:ravager.summary: A large raid enemy with heavy close-range pressure.
minecraft:ravager.advice: Give yourself room to evade and avoid being pinned against terrain.

minecraft:guardian.summary: An aquatic ranged enemy that protects Ocean Monuments.
minecraft:guardian.encounter: Spawns in water around Ocean Monuments, by day as well as at night.
minecraft:guardian.advice: Break its line of sight during its beam attack and prepare reliable underwater breathing. [[item/minecraft:prismarine|Prismarine]] materials are its main ordinary rewards.

minecraft:elder_guardian.summary: A large monument defender that inflicts Mining Fatigue.
minecraft:elder_guardian.encounter: A limited number generate with each Ocean Monument; they do not form an ordinary renewable spawning population.
minecraft:elder_guardian.advice: Defeating the monument's Elders makes exploration and harvesting easier.

minecraft:breeze.summary: A mobile Trial Chamber enemy that attacks with wind.
minecraft:breeze.encounter: Comes from suitable Trial Chamber spawners.

minecraft:warden.summary: A powerful Deep Dark threat that responds to sound and vibration.
minecraft:warden.encounter: Can emerge after repeated warnings from naturally generated [[item/minecraft:sculk_shrieker|Sculk Shriekers]] under suitable conditions. It is not an ordinary dark-room spawn.
minecraft:warden.advice: Avoidance is often safer than combat.

minecraft:blaze.summary: A flying, fire-associated Nether Fortress enemy.
minecraft:blaze.encounter: Found in Nether Fortresses, including around Blaze spawners.

minecraft:wither_skeleton.summary: A tall Nether Fortress melee enemy.
minecraft:wither_skeleton.encounter: Spawns in Nether Fortresses under suitable conditions.
minecraft:wither_skeleton.advice: Leave room to retreat and account for [[mob/minecraft:wither|Wither]] on contact. Its Skull is a rare player-kill drop used to summon the [[mob/minecraft:wither|Wither]].

minecraft:ghast.summary: A large flying Nether enemy that launches explosive fireballs.
minecraft:ghast.encounter: Appears in suitable open Nether environments.
minecraft:ghast.advice: Fight from safe footing and plan how to retrieve drops over lava. Fireballs can be deflected.

minecraft:magma_cube.encounter: Appears in suitable Nether environments and some Bastion areas.
minecraft:magma_cube.advice: Large cubes split into smaller ones.

minecraft:piglin.summary: A neutral Nether inhabitant that reacts to Gold and aggression.
minecraft:piglin.encounter: Appears in suitable Nether biomes and Bastion Remnants.
minecraft:piglin.advice: Wearing Gold can prevent ordinary unprovoked aggression, but opening containers or attacking can still provoke it. Adult Piglins barter with [[item/minecraft:gold_ingot|Gold Ingots]].

minecraft:piglin_brute.encounter: Generates in Bastion Remnants and does not respawn as an ordinary population.
minecraft:piglin_brute.advice: Gold clothing does not pacify it.

minecraft:zombified_piglin.encounter: Appears in suitable Nether environments and can result from [[mob/minecraft:piglin|Piglin]] conversion or lightning striking a [[mob/minecraft:pig|Pig]].
minecraft:zombified_piglin.advice: Unprovoked groups are normally neutral. Attacking one can bring nearby allies into the fight.

minecraft:hoglin.summary: A large hostile animal and a Nether food source.
minecraft:hoglin.encounter: Appears in Crimson Forests and some Bastion areas.
minecraft:hoglin.advice: Manage its knockback near lava and ledges. Adults can provide Pork and [[item/minecraft:leather|Leather]].

minecraft:zoglin.encounter: Forms when a [[mob/minecraft:hoglin|Hoglin]] remains outside the Nether long enough to convert.
minecraft:zoglin.advice: It attacks many nearby creatures and cannot be treated as ordinary breedable livestock.

minecraft:strider.encounter: Appears on Nether lava under suitable conditions.
minecraft:strider.advice: It becomes slow when cold, away from lava.

minecraft:shulker.encounter: Generates in End Cities; special projectile interactions can create additional Shulkers under suitable conditions.

minecraft:ender_dragon.encounter: The first Dragon is on the central End island. To summon another, place four [[item/minecraft:end_crystal|End Crystals]] at the middle of the four sides of the [[item/minecraft:bedrock|Bedrock]] exit portal.
minecraft:ender_dragon.advice: Plan for flight, knockback, healing crystals and safe movement around the island. Its rewards include access to further End exploration. The first defeat also creates the [[item/minecraft:dragon_egg|Dragon Egg]]. Collect Dragon Breath from its lingering breath with [[item/minecraft:glass_bottle|Glass Bottles]].

minecraft:wither.encounter: Build a horizontal T of four [[item/minecraft:soul_sand|Soul Sand]] or [[item/minecraft:soul_soil|Soul Soil]] blocks, then place three [[item/minecraft:wither_skeleton_skull|Wither Skeleton Skulls]] across the top. Place a skull last to complete the ritual, and prepare the arena before doing so.
minecraft:wither.advice: Choose the arena before summoning it. Its attacks and explosions make an accidental fight near your base especially destructive.

minecraft:cow.summary: A passive livestock animal and renewable [[item/minecraft:leather|Leather]] source.
minecraft:cow.encounter: Found in suitable grassy Overworld biomes.
minecraft:cow.advice: Breed with [[item/minecraft:wheat|Wheat]]. A [[item/minecraft:bucket|Bucket]] can collect Milk; killing a Cow supplies Beef and potentially [[item/minecraft:leather|Leather]].

minecraft:pig.summary: A passive livestock animal and a supported mount.
minecraft:pig.encounter: Found in suitable grassy Overworld biomes.
minecraft:pig.advice: Breed with suitable root crops. Naming currently claims it for the mount system; use a [[item/minecraft:saddle|Saddle]] and [[item/minecraft:carrot_on_a_stick|Carrot on a Stick]] to ride it.

minecraft:sheep.summary: A passive livestock animal useful for renewable Wool.
minecraft:sheep.encounter: Found in suitable grassy Overworld biomes.
minecraft:sheep.advice: Breed with [[item/minecraft:wheat|Wheat]]. Shear it for Wool without killing it; it can regrow Wool by eating grass.

minecraft:chicken.summary: A passive animal useful for [[item/minecraft:feather|Feathers]], [[item/minecraft:egg|Eggs]] and food.
minecraft:chicken.encounter: Found in many suitable Overworld biomes.
minecraft:chicken.advice: Breed with suitable seeds. Adult Chickens lay [[item/minecraft:egg|Eggs]], providing a renewable interaction reward beyond their death drops.

minecraft:rabbit.summary: A small animal found in several dry, snowy and meadow environments.
minecraft:rabbit.encounter: Look in the listed suitable biomes rather than assuming all grasslands contain Rabbits.
minecraft:rabbit.advice: Breed with suitable vegetables. [[item/minecraft:rabbit_hide|Rabbit Hide]] and a rare [[item/minecraft:rabbit_foot|Rabbit's Foot]] are notable materials.

minecraft:mooshroom.advice: Other interactions depend on its variant; shearing converts it into a [[mob/minecraft:cow|Cow]].

minecraft:horse.summary: A rideable animal with inherited movement and survival traits.
minecraft:horse.encounter: Found naturally in Plains and Savannas.
minecraft:horse.advice: Tame it through repeated riding, then use its inventory for equipment, ownership and breeding focus. See the mount guides before choosing breeding stock.

minecraft:donkey.encounter: Found in suitable Plains, Meadow and Savanna environments.
minecraft:donkey.advice: Tame it through riding. It supports cargo and can breed with a [[mob/minecraft:horse|Horse]] to produce a [[mob/minecraft:mule|Mule]].

minecraft:mule.summary: A pack animal produced by crossbreeding.
minecraft:mule.encounter: Breed a [[mob/minecraft:horse|Horse]] with a [[mob/minecraft:donkey|Donkey]]; Mules do not form ordinary wild herds.

minecraft:camel.summary: A two-seat mount associated with desert settlements.
minecraft:camel.encounter: Generates in Desert Villages rather than an ordinary renewable wild spawning population.
minecraft:camel.advice: Name it with a [[item/minecraft:name_tag|Name Tag]] to claim it in the current mount system. It breeds with [[item/minecraft:cactus|Cactus]] and has a dash rather than a [[mob/minecraft:horse|Horse]]'s jump.

minecraft:llama.summary: A pack animal with variant cargo capacity.
minecraft:llama.encounter: Found in suitable mountain and Savanna environments.
minecraft:llama.advice: Tame it through riding. It uses carpet decoration and cargo; breeding and transport rules are described in the mount guides.

minecraft:trader_llama.encounter: Appears with a [[mob/minecraft:wandering_trader|Wandering Trader]] rather than ordinary wild herds.
minecraft:trader_llama.advice: Its initial trader relationship differs from a wild [[mob/minecraft:llama|Llama]].

minecraft:wolf.summary: A tameable companion with biome-dependent variants.
minecraft:wolf.encounter: Found in suitable forest, taiga, grove and other variant-specific biomes.

minecraft:cat.summary: A tameable companion associated with settlements.
minecraft:cat.encounter: Appears around suitable Villages and Swamp Huts.
minecraft:cat.advice: Tame with raw fish. A tamed Cat can help deter nearby [[mob/minecraft:creeper|Creepers]] and [[mob/minecraft:phantom|Phantoms]].

minecraft:ocelot.advice: Build trust using raw fish. An Ocelot does not become a [[mob/minecraft:cat|Cat]] through taming.

minecraft:fox.summary: A shy animal that can carry items.
minecraft:fox.encounter: Found in suitable taiga and grove environments.
minecraft:fox.advice: Breed with suitable Berries. A trusted offspring behaves differently from a wild Fox.

minecraft:parrot.advice: Tame with suitable seeds. [[item/minecraft:cookie|Cookies]] are poisonous to Parrots.

minecraft:polar_bear.encounter: Found in suitable snowy and frozen environments.

minecraft:panda.summary: A jungle animal with inherited personalities.
minecraft:panda.encounter: Found in Jungle and [[item/minecraft:bamboo|Bamboo]] Jungle environments.
minecraft:panda.advice: [[item/minecraft:bamboo|Bamboo]] is central to its care and breeding. Different personalities affect its behaviour.

minecraft:bee.summary: A neutral pollinator with hive-based products.
minecraft:bee.encounter: Found through [[item/minecraft:bee_nest|Bee Nests]] and [[item/minecraft:beehive|Beehives]]; nests can generate with suitable trees and be produced by some tree-growth conditions.
minecraft:bee.advice: Flowers and a safe hive area support honey production. Disturbing a hive can provoke the bees; smoke can make harvesting safer.

minecraft:goat.summary: A mountain animal that can ram targets.
minecraft:goat.encounter: Found on suitable mountain slopes and peaks.
minecraft:goat.advice: Careful positioning can let a ram break a Horn against an appropriate solid block. Horns are an interaction reward, not a normal kill drop.

minecraft:frog.summary: A small amphibian with biome-dependent variants.
minecraft:frog.encounter: Found in Swamps and Mangrove Swamps. The temperature where a [[mob/minecraft:tadpole|Tadpole]] grows determines its Frog variant.
minecraft:frog.advice: Frogs eat small [[mob/minecraft:slime|Slimes]] and [[mob/minecraft:magma_cube|Magma Cubes]]. Eating a small [[mob/minecraft:magma_cube|Magma Cube]] produces a Froglight, with colour determined by the Frog variant.

minecraft:tadpole.summary: The juvenile stage that grows into a [[mob/minecraft:frog|Frog]].
minecraft:tadpole.advice: Move it in a water [[item/minecraft:bucket|Bucket]] if you want to choose the temperature where it grows into a particular [[mob/minecraft:frog|Frog]] variant.

minecraft:turtle.summary: A coastal animal with useful non-lethal shell rewards.
minecraft:turtle.advice: Breed with [[item/minecraft:seagrass|Seagrass]]. Protect eggs and young Turtles; a Scute is dropped when a baby grows up, not by routinely killing adults.

minecraft:armadillo.summary: A passive source of protective Scutes.
minecraft:armadillo.encounter: Found in suitable Savanna and Badlands environments.
minecraft:armadillo.advice: [[item/minecraft:brush|Brush]] it for Scutes or collect naturally shed ones. Scutes are useful for [[item/minecraft:wolf_armor|Wolf Armour]] without killing the Armadillo.

minecraft:sniffer.summary: An ancient animal that finds special seeds.
minecraft:sniffer.encounter: Hatch a [[item/minecraft:sniffer_egg|Sniffer Egg]] recovered from appropriate warm Ocean Ruin archaeology.
minecraft:sniffer.advice: Provide suitable ground and space for digging. Its special plant finds are interaction rewards rather than ordinary death drops.

minecraft:iron_golem.summary: A powerful protector associated with Villages.
minecraft:iron_golem.encounter: Can form through Village conditions or be built by the player using Iron Blocks and a carved [[item/minecraft:pumpkin|Pumpkin]].
minecraft:iron_golem.advice: It can defend a settlement, but provoking one is dangerous. [[item/minecraft:iron_ingot|Iron Ingots]] and Poppies are its ordinary drops.

minecraft:snow_golem.encounter: Build it from [[item/minecraft:snow_block|Snow Blocks]] and a carved [[item/minecraft:pumpkin|Pumpkin]].
minecraft:snow_golem.advice: It can leave a harvestable [[item/minecraft:snow|Snow]] trail in suitable conditions. Hot environments and water can harm it.

minecraft:allay.summary: A friendly flying helper that collects matching items.
minecraft:allay.encounter: Find trapped Allays in suitable [[mob/minecraft:pillager|Pillager]] Outposts or Woodland Mansion rooms.
minecraft:allay.advice: Give it an item to indicate what to collect. Its utility is collection, not kill loot.

minecraft:villager.summary: A settlement inhabitant with trades and workstation behaviour.
minecraft:villager.encounter: Found in Villages, produced through breeding or obtained by curing a [[mob/minecraft:zombie_villager|Zombie Villager]].
minecraft:villager.advice: Trades and workstation behaviour depend on the Villager's current profession. Protect useful trading partners from hostile creatures, and check their offers before spending rare materials.

minecraft:wandering_trader.summary: A travelling merchant with rotating offers.
minecraft:wandering_trader.encounter: Appears near players under suitable Overworld conditions.
minecraft:wandering_trader.advice: It can provide otherwise distant natural materials. Offers are limited; it is not a permanent workstation-bound [[mob/minecraft:villager|Villager]].

minecraft:squid.encounter: Found in suitable river and ocean waters.
minecraft:squid.advice: It needs water to survive. Ink is useful for dyes and alchemical preparation.

minecraft:glow_squid.summary: An underground aquatic source of [[item/minecraft:glow_ink_sac|Glow Ink Sacs]].
minecraft:glow_squid.encounter: Found in suitable dark underground waters.
minecraft:glow_squid.advice: Glow Ink is useful for illuminated text and glowing alchemical materials; its glow is not a general source of block light.

minecraft:cod.encounter: Found in suitable ocean waters and through fishing.
minecraft:cod.advice: Collect it for cooking or move a living fish using a water [[item/minecraft:bucket|Bucket]]. [[item/minecraft:campfire|Campfires]] and [[item/minecraft:smoker|Smokers]] both cook Cod.

minecraft:salmon.summary: An edible fish associated with cold waters and rivers.
minecraft:salmon.encounter: Found in suitable rivers and oceans and through fishing.
minecraft:salmon.advice: Cook it at a [[item/minecraft:campfire|Campfire]] or [[item/minecraft:smoker|Smoker]], or move a living fish with a water [[item/minecraft:bucket|Bucket]].

minecraft:tropical_fish.encounter: Found in warm ocean and suitable lush-cave waters, and through fishing.
minecraft:tropical_fish.advice: A [[item/minecraft:tropical_fish_bucket|Bucket of Tropical Fish]] is useful for [[mob/minecraft:axolotl|Axolotl]] care and breeding. Its live form has uses beyond eating the item.

minecraft:pufferfish.encounter: Found in suitable warm and lukewarm ocean waters and through fishing.

minecraft:dolphin.summary: A neutral ocean animal with travel utility.
minecraft:dolphin.encounter: Found in suitable non-frozen ocean waters.
minecraft:dolphin.advice: Swimming nearby can help with water travel. Feeding raw fish can lead it toward certain underwater treasure structures.

minecraft:axolotl.summary: An aquatic companion that hunts other water creatures.
minecraft:axolotl.encounter: Found in suitable water within Lush Caves, near [[item/minecraft:clay|Clay]].
minecraft:axolotl.advice: Collect it in a water [[item/minecraft:bucket|Bucket]]. [[item/minecraft:bucket|Buckets]] of [[item/minecraft:tropical_fish|Tropical Fish]] are used for breeding; ordinary fish items are not the same thing.

minecraft:bat.encounter: Found in suitable dark underground spaces.
minecraft:bat.advice: Usually encountered as ambient cave wildlife rather than a combat threat.

minecraft:skeleton_horse.encounter: A rare thunderstorm trap can create Skeleton Horses and armed riders. Triggering a trap begins a dangerous encounter.
minecraft:skeleton_horse.advice: Deal with the riders and check the surviving [[mob/minecraft:horse|Horse]]'s mount panel. It is not an ordinary breedable [[mob/minecraft:horse|Horse]] population.

minecraft:zombie_horse.encounter: Has no ordinary natural survival spawn in this version; it is normally introduced through Creative or commands.
minecraft:zombie_horse.advice: If one is present, use its supported mount-management interface rather than assuming the living [[mob/minecraft:horse|Horse]]'s breeding rules apply.

minecraft:illusioner.summary: An Illager spellcaster with illusion abilities.
minecraft:illusioner.encounter: Has no ordinary natural survival spawn in this version; it is normally introduced through Creative or commands.
minecraft:illusioner.advice: Its illusions and ranged attacks require attention to the real attacker rather than attacking every visible copy.

minecraft:giant.encounter: Has no ordinary natural survival spawn in this version; it is normally introduced through Creative or commands.
minecraft:giant.advice: Its existence in Creative does not make it a normal resource-hunting target.
